Fence repository-local agent capabilities

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-62
  description: |-
    Reject unsealed Cursor and Grok repository capability sources at their provider spawn boundaries. Cursor preserves its guarded MCP replacement while failing before mutation for other local config, Plugin, or Skill sources; Grok applies repository isolation only to sealed binding launches, leaving operator-home startup preflight intact.
    
    Add focused tests proving the rejected sources cannot spawn a provider process or mutate the guarded Cursor MCP configuration.
